claims.claim: Recursion's causal path is computational/experimental drug discovery -> better target and molecule selection -> clinical candidates -> therapies; the Genentech joint-program advancement and REC-7735 IND clearance support movement across early links, but do not yet validate human efficacy or commercial translation.

factors.name: bottleneckControl
factors.basis: Integrated data/automation can compress discovery iteration, but clinical validation remains an external successor bottleneck.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: Partner programs diversify discovery validation while outcomes remain exposed to binary clinical translation.

factors.name: substitutionResilience
factors.basis: Platform scale and partner integration can create switching friction, but competing AI/automation and conventional discovery approaches remain substitutes.

risks.risk: Clinical translation can break the causal chain even when discovery-stage milestones are achieved.

unknowns.unknown: Human efficacy for REC-7735 and other platform-derived programs remains unproven.

claims.claim: The strongest present falsification pressure is translation and financing duration, not evidence of misconduct: Q2 collaboration revenue fell year over year while the business remained loss-making, despite a reported cash runway into early 2028.

factors.name: financing/dilution
factors.basis: Meaningful cash burn persists before product economics are proven; runway reduces near-term pressure but does not remove future financing risk.

factors.name: source dependence
factors.basis: Current packet evidence is issuer-originated, so confidence should remain below certainty until independent clinical/partner evidence accumulates.

factors.name: confidence inflation
factors.basis: Partner advancement and IND clearance are validation steps, not proof of efficacy or commercial success.

risks.risk: Milestone-sensitive revenue and clinical burn can require additional capital if translation takes longer than runway assumptions.

unknowns.unknown: Future dilution magnitude and timing cannot be established from current evidence.
